New queens, new crowns, ZERO rules on how big you serve 👑✨ Abele Fantasy is hosting Azucar's first-ever Amateur Drag Pageant and mama, esto va en serio. Three rounds — talent, gala wear, and pure beauty — porque una reina no se hace en una noche, se hace en TRES. Sign up to compete or grab a seat and watch the crown get earned live on the Main Floor. Trae tu mejor cara y tu corazón valiente, this is your shot at the spotlight. 💃🏽🔥

Wednesday, August 19th • 8PM Show Time
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $15-$25

Picture it: lights hot pink, glitter en el aire, y una fila de reinas nerviosas-pero-fabulosas esperando su momento 💗✨ That's the Amateur Drag Pageant vibe — talent that gives you chills, gala looks that make you gasp, beauty round that seals the deal. Abele Fantasy commanding the room like only she can, la energía subiendo con cada categoría. You'll feel every heartbeat de esa reina cuando camina el stage buscando la corona. This isn't just a show, es una experiencia que se siente en el pecho. 🎤🖤

No perfect look required, solo corazón valiente 💖 The Amateur Drag Pageant is for the queens who've been practicing in the mirror, the ones ready to serve their FIRST crown moment, and the familia showing up to scream their name. Abele Fantasy hosts a night where talent, gala wear, and beauty se celebran a la manera de cada quien — no hay un solo molde aquí. Come as you are, cheer like it's your own sister on that stage, and watch Pasco crown its next star. Sign up to compete or just come pack the room with love. 👑🫶🏽
